title: MV Moghunters Chrono Engine - Need help with adding own stuff

posts.author: LittleLynx
posts.body:
Hi!
I'm very (VERY!) new to editing plugins, coding and need help with adding my own tool-items (like the hookshot etc that it has already implemented) within Moghunters Chrono Engine.
I looked and searched within the code if I can make sense of it (at least for my range of understanding so far) but sadly not. How can I write funtioning tools and how and where do I edit the plugin file?
What I would like to have:
- A Tool-Item that highlights specific events on the map when the item-button is being pressed
- 3 that starts a ceratin event when the item-button is being pressed while being near it (like listening to ghost-NPCs when the button is pressed while standing in front or beside of them for an example and that for 3 different items for 3 different kinds of events)
Sorry if there is already a thread or guide for that but didn't found one. ^^'
And thanks in advance for the help!

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Neither of those require editing the plugin file but they do require you to use a script on the tool event page and maybe another plugin to add a highlight effect to an event.
Could you be more specific what events you want to be highlighted?

posts.author: LittleLynx
posts.body:
Oh okay that would be awesome of course if it´s possible via eventing!
Item 1 should highlight events that "mark" hidden passages on a map (like illusionary walls and overgrown pathways) when the item-button is pressed
Item 2 should make tracks (may it via events that become vissible or show-picture-command like a scent-track or ghostly footprints) vissible. (again on button-press/item use)
Item 3 should trigger on button-press a text-event when standing next to/in front of a specific event (like a shrine for an example) so the player is able to listen to spirits when using this item

posts.author: AquaEcho
LittleLynx
AquaEcho
posts.body: You need to put the script in the tool event page (on the tool map). I never said to use the database entry

posts.author: LittleLynx
posts.body:
Oh my gosh, hit me but I just found the tool map... (actually searched through the entire code, item list etc etc to find what you could mean (like a code segment or something) and just didn't notice the named tool map in the demo of the plugin demo... ...
Works like a charm now of course, was super easy - thank you so much for the help and template code! ^^'

The skill and item menus are new menus added by the Chrono Engine plugin so they work different than the ones built into RPG Maker. As far as I know the new menus don't have scrolling coded into them but I haven't added enough entries to test it.

If the issue is not reproducible in the stock demo then this is just going to be an exercise in "guess what things you changed in your game to create the problem".
